node: Foodservice distribution, direct-store-delivery, and route-density logistics
summary: Expanded the universe around dense restaurant distribution routes and specialty foodservice logistics. The underfollowed lane is more attractive than broadline leaders for this pass: CHEF has specialty independent-restaurant density, WEST has beverage/coffee foodservice supply-chain exposure but less direct DSD evidence, and HFFG is a micro-cap speculative exception with unusually direct Asian-restaurant distribution exposure. PFGC is retained as a reference/context anchor because its Foodservice, Specialty, and Convenience segments show the scale economics and route-density model that smaller names are trying to exploit.
